content_text:
I recently found a Nat Geo documentary on six episodes: six fascinating photographers. Dan Winters being the one that I found most inspiring (the others are great, too), but he just caught my breath. The way he devotes his life, with his passion and commitment to the art of photography. I am not an intellectual, but I feel that Winters has a unique connection to the art, craft and the history of photography on a very human level.
Hope you can watch the documentary series, streaming now on Disney+. It is worth your while. Hope it inspires you. So, please, do it up. Cheers and have a great year.
